H10E01:
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c1.category_name
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
)
SELECT oc.category_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.city = s.city THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(o.pay_amount), 2)
FROM fact_order o
JOIN oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = o.shop_id
WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oc.category_name
H10E03:
WITH f AS (
    SELECT user_id, channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY create_time) AS rn
    FROM fact_order
), us AS (
    SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS amt
    FROM fact_order GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT f.channel, ROUND(AVG(us.amt), 2)
FROM f JOIN us ON us.user_id = f.user_id
WHERE f.rn = 1
GROUP BY f.channel
H10E04:
WITH f AS (
    SELECT o.user_id, MIN(p.pay_time) AS first_pay
    FROM fact_payment p JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY o.user_id
)
SELECT u.member_level,
       ROUND(AVG(julianday(date(f.first_pay)) - julianday(u.register_time)), 1)
FROM dim_user u JOIN f ON f.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.member_level
H10E05:
SELECT p.brand, SUM(i.quantity)
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = o.shop_id
JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = s.main_category_id
JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE u.member_level = '金卡会员' AND c1.category_name = '数码电器' AND o.order_status = '已完成'
GROUP BY p.brand
H10E11:
SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*)
FROM dws_user_summary s
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = s.user_id AND o.create_time = s.last_order_time
GROUP BY o.order_status
H10E13:
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c1.category_name
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
),
t AS (
    SELECT oc.category_name, p.pay_channel, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS amt
    FROM fact_payment p
    JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oc.category_name, p.pay_channel
), r AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY amt DESC) rk FROM t
)
SELECT category_name, pay_channel, ROUND(amt, 2) FROM r WHERE rk = 1
H10E14:
WITH d AS (
    SELECT date(pay_time) AS pay_date, SUM(pay_amount) AS amt
    FROM fact_payment GROUP BY date(pay_time)
), c AS (
    SELECT pay_date, SUM(amt) OVER (ORDER BY pay_date) AS cum_amt FROM d
)
SELECT MIN(pay_date) FROM c WHERE cum_amt > 5000000
H10E16:
WITH us AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, u.age_group,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN o.pay_amount END), 0) AS amt
    FROM dim_user u LEFT JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
    GROUP BY u.user_id, u.age_group
)
SELECT age_group, ROUND(AVG(amt), 2) FROM us GROUP BY age_group
H10E17:
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c1.category_name
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
),
uc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id, oc.category_name
    FROM fact_order o JOIN oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT user_id FROM uc WHERE category_name IN ('美妆护肤', '数码电器')
    GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) = 2
) x
H10E19:
WITH d AS (
    SELECT date(o.create_time) AS dt, SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv
    FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = o.shop_id
    WHERE s.shop_name = '好物专营店14'
    GROUP BY date(o.create_time)
), t AS (
    SELECT dt, gmv, LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS prev_gmv FROM d
)
SELECT dt, ROUND(gmv, 2) FROM t WHERE prev_gmv IS NOT NULL AND gmv >= 2 * prev_gmv
H10E20:
SELECT c1.category_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = '加购' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = '浏览' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1)
FROM fact_user_behavior b
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = b.product_id
JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = p.shop_id
JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = s.main_category_id
JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
GROUP BY c1.category_name
H10E22:
SELECT s.shop_type, ROUND(AVG(t.g), 2)
FROM dim_shop s
JOIN (SELECT shop_id, SUM(order_amount) AS g FROM fact_order GROUP BY shop_id) t ON t.shop_id = s.shop_id
GROUP BY s.shop_type
H10E23:
SELECT s.shop_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN date(o.create_time) >= '2024-05-16' THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END)
                      - SUM(CASE WHEN date(o.create_time) <= '2024-05-15' THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END))
             / SUM(CASE WHEN date(o.create_time) <= '2024-05-15' THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END), 2)
FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = o.shop_id
GROUP BY s.shop_id, s.shop_name
H10E24:
SELECT u.member_level,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.item_price >= 3000 THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(i.quantity), 2)
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.member_level
H10E25:
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c1.category_name
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id)
FROM fact_user_behavior b
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = b.product_id
JOIN dim_shop s ON s.shop_id = p.shop_id
JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = s.main_category_id
JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id
WHERE b.behavior_type = '收藏' AND c1.category_name = '食品生鲜'
  AND b.user_id NOT IN (
      SELECT o.user_id FROM fact_order o JOIN oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id
      WHERE o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND oc.category_name = '食品生鲜'
  )
H10E26:
SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = '已退款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
GROUP BY o.user_id, u.user_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = '已退款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 >= COUNT(*)

SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(o.order_id), COUNT(r.refund_id)
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
LEFT JOIN fact_refund r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.user_id, u.user_name
HAVING COUNT(r.refund_id) * 2 >= COUNT(o.order_id)
H10C02:
WITH cs AS (
    SELECT i.BillingCountry AS country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS spend
    FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
), big AS (
    SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) >= 4
), r AS (
    SELECT cs.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spend DESC) rk
    FROM cs WHERE country IN (SELECT BillingCountry FROM big)
)
SELECT country, FirstName, LastName, ROUND(spend, 2) FROM r WHERE rk = 1
H10C03:
SELECT DISTINCT c.Country
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Blues'
  AND c.Country NOT IN (
      SELECT c2.Country
      FROM Customer c2
      JOIN Invoice i2 ON i2.CustomerId = c2.CustomerId
      JOIN InvoiceLine il2 ON il2.InvoiceId = i2.InvoiceId
      JOIN Track t2 ON t2.TrackId = il2.TrackId
      JOIN Genre g2 ON g2.GenreId = t2.GenreId
      WHERE g2.Name = 'Jazz'
  )
H10C11:
SELECT c.Country, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2)
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
GROUP BY c.Country
H10S05:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT i.store_id, strftime('%Y-%m', r.rental_date) AS ym, SUM(p.amount) AS amt
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.store_id, ym
), l AS (
    SELECT store_id, ym, amt, LAG(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY ym) AS prev_amt FROM m
)
SELECT store_id, ym, ROUND(100.0 * (amt - prev_amt) / prev_amt, 2) FROM l
WHERE ym BETWEEN '2005-06' AND '2005-08'
